deep_dives.macro_sensitivity: Low rate sensitivity, high sensitivity to Taiwan geopolitical risk and USD/KRW cross (Korean competitor pricing); VIX spikes above 20 would hit MU's ~1.9x beta hard given the semiconductor correlation.
key_catalysts: Q4 (CQ3) earnings report likely late August — HBM shipment guidance and ASP trajectory will be the binary event
NVIDIA GTC / AI infrastructure buildout data points confirming HBM demand TAM expansion
Any additional CHIPS Act disbursement for US fab expansion
deep_dives.disconfirming_evidence: If Samsung accelerates HBM3E commercial production faster than expected and ASPs compress, or if quarterly GM guidance comes in below 36%, the supply-discipline thesis breaks and MU trades back toward $110-120.
deep_dives.bull_scenario: Q4 EPS beats + HBM demand surprises to upside → $170-180 (+18-22%)
deep_dives.base_scenario: Range continues between $140-160 with modest upside drift toward $155 (+3-5%) over 3-21 days as vol compresses and base builds
deep_dives.bear_scenario: Memory pricing headwinds or weak guidance → retest $130-135 (-7-10%)
